title: I like them, but why no hooks?
text: I like them, but why no hooks?. The product itself is nice and exactly what I’m looking for to help with morning routines with my preschool aged twins. I love the organization. But I was surprised when I opened the package that the hooks to hang them weren’t included. I looked back, and the description didn’t say they were included, so it’s my own fault for assuming. But it seems like something that really should be included. I was a bit disappointed because I was very ready to hang them when I received them. So just a warning to someone else shopping, the product is great but don’t forget to buy hooks!
